transcript: Speaker A: मीना, कस्टमर को क्या दिया तूने? क्रोसिन मांगी थी उसने, तूने कॉम्बीफ्लैम दे दी... प्रिस्क्रिप्शन पढ़ के देख, इंग्लिश में लिखा है... [Meena, what did you give the customer? He asked for Crocin, you gave him Combiflam... Read the prescription, it's written in English...] Speaker B: सर, प्रिस्क्रिप्शन में बहुत छोटा लिखा था, इंग्लिश में। समझ नहीं आया। [Sir, it was written very small in the prescription, in English. I didn't understand.] Speaker A: समझ नहीं आया तो मेडिकल शॉप में काम क्यों करती हो? गलत दवाई दोगी तो पेशेंट मर जायेगा... [If you didn't understand, why do you work in a medical shop? If you give the wrong medicine, the patient will die...] Speaker B: सर, एक मिनट देना मुझे... This prescription says Tab Amoxicillin 500 mg... Patient को तीन दवाई देनी है... [Sir, give me a minute... This prescription says Tab Amoxicillin 500 mg... We have to give three medicines to the patient...] Speaker A: तूने ये कब सीखा? [When did you learn this?] Speaker B: सर, 'English Seekho' ऐप डाउनलोड की। जनरल इंग्लिश शो से स्टार्ट किया... AI कोच है, 24 घंटे अवेलेबल है... [Sir, I downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. Started with the General English show... There is an AI coach, available 24 hours...] Speaker A: मीना, आज से तू काउंटर पे बैठेगी। [Meena, from today you will sit at the counter.] Speaker B: सर, थैंक यू... आपकी दूसरी ब्रांच में भी दो लड़कियां हैं... अगर वो भी 'English Seekho' ऐप डाउनलोड करें... तो एक महीने में प्रिस्क्रिप्शन पढ़ लेंगी। [Sir, thank you... There are two girls in your other branch too... If they also download the 'English Seekho' app... they will read prescriptions in a month.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A pharmacy assistant is scolded by her boss for misreading an English prescription and dispensing the wrong medicine. She uses the English Seekho app and its AI coach to learn medical terms and abbreviations, earning a promotion to the counter. She then recommends the app to help other staff members improve their English skills.
